decision: Repair strict lint failures while retaining the existing D-Bus and exact-observation contracts.
reason: The restored full release gate reaches previously hidden Clippy failures. Preserve fixed wire arguments and the explicit token/text/revision/expiry publisher instead of changing an input protocol or introducing a new authority payload solely for a style threshold.
verification: Use the repository's existing narrowly scoped expect(too_many_arguments) convention on exactly three explicit contracts. No dead-code inventory, verifier assertion or source test is waived. Remove unused imports and redundant wrapper; simplify pure boolean/Option expressions; put test mutex guards in lexical scopes before await. Run both locked feature-profile lint gates and full source tests.
not_tested: These source maintenance changes alone do not certify native clients.
